title: dryopteris ternata
intro: Dryopteris ternata, commonly known as the Ostrich Fern, is a type of flowering plant in the fern family (Dryopteridaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which are said to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects that aid in soothing digestive issues, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of the Ostrich Fern include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, while also exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been found to possess significant pharmacological activities.
